put.summary: Update an existing category budget limit
put.description: Modifies the limit amount for an already existing account budget category.

400.description: Invalid input data or negative limit amount

404.description: Budget for the specified account and category combination was not found

post.summary: Set a new category budget limit
post.description: Defines a fresh spending limit for a specific category on a selected account.

400.description: Invalid input parameters or validation failed

404.description: The specified account does not exist

get.description: Retrieves a paginated list of transactions, optionally filtered by date range and category.

parameters.name: pageable
parameters.description: Pagination and sorting parameters (e.g., page=0, size=10, sort=date,desc)

200.description: Paginated list of transactions successfully retrieved

post.description: Registers a new financial transaction (Income or Expense). If it is an Expense, it also evaluates the category budget status.

400.description: Invalid input data or budget/account processing failure

404.description: The specified account ID does not exist

get.description: Retrieves a full list of all registered personal accounts with their current balances.

post.description: Creates a new personal account with an initial name and balance.

400.description: Invalid input data or validation failed

get.summary: Get all budgets for an account
get.description: Retrieves a list of all defined category limits associated with a specific account ID.

parameters.name: accountId
parameters.description: ID of the account to fetch budgets for

404.description: Account with the given ID does not exist

get.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific account by its unique identifier.

404.description: Account with the given ID does not exist

delete.description: Deletes an account from the system. Deletion is only permitted if the account has no associated transactions.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the account to delete

404.description: Account with the given ID does not exist

409.description: Cannot delete account because it contains related transactions

get.summary: Get financial analytics for an account
get.description: Calculates total income, total expenses, and groups expenses by category within a specified time range for a given account.

parameters.name: accountId
parameters.description: ID of the account to analyze

parameters.name: fromDate
parameters.description: Start date-time of the analysis period (ISO format)

parameters.name: toDate
parameters.description: End date-time of the analysis period (ISO format)

200.description: Financial analytics successfully calculated and retrieved

400.description: Invalid date-time format or missing request parameters

404.description: Account with the specified ID was not found

delete.description: Removes a specific transaction by its unique database ID and automatically reverts its impact on the account balance.

404.description: Transaction with the given ID does not exist

delete.description: Removes a specific category budget limit from the system completely using its unique database ID.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the budget limit configuration

404.description: Budget limit with the given ID does not exist

CategoryBudgetUpdateCommand.description: Data required to update an existing category spending limit

accountId.description: ID of the account associated with the budget

category.description: The targeted budget category to modify

limitAmount.description: The new maximum spending threshold. Must be greater than zero.

CreateTransactionCommand.description: Data required to create a new income or expense transaction

amount.description: The monetary value of the transaction. Must be positive.

category.description: The financial category associated with this transaction

description.description: Optional custom description or notes regarding the transaction

date.description: The date and time when the transaction occurred (ISO format)

accountId.description: The database identifier of the account this transaction belongs to

TransactionResponseDto.description: Detailed response information representing a registered transaction and its current category budget impacts

id.description: The unique database identifier of the transaction

amount.description: The monetary value of the transaction

type.description: The type classification of the transaction

category.description: The specific spending or income category

description.description: The description or note assigned to this entry

date.description: The registered date and time of the transaction

accountId.description: The identifier of the associated account

budgetExceeded.description: Flag indicating if the current month's budget limit for this category has been exceeded after inserting this transaction

spentInCategory.description: Total accumulated spending amount in this specific category for the current month so far

CreateCategoryBudgetCreateCommand.description: Data required to set a new spending limit configuration for a category

accountId.description: ID of the account to assign the budget to

category.description: The target category for the limit

limitAmount.description: Maximum allowed spending amount for this category. Must be greater than zero.

name.description: The unique name of the account

AccountResponseDto.description: Response data containing details of a personal account and its current balance

id.description: The unique database identifier of the account

name.description: The name given to the account

balance.description: The current monetary balance available in the account

TransactionFilterCriteria.description: Criteria parameters used for filtering the paginated transaction list

AccountAnalyticsResponseDto.description: Response data containing comprehensive financial analytics and summaries for a specific account

period.description: The time range period for which the analytics were calculated

totalIncome.description: Total accumulated income within the requested period

totalExpenses.description: Total accumulated expenses within the requested period

expensesByCategory.description: Breakdown of total expenses grouped by each individual category

ExpenseByCategoryDto.description: Aggregated details of expenses for a specific category, including its percentage share of total spending

category.description: The financial category of the expense

amount.description: The total monetary amount spent in this category within the period

percentage.description: The percentage share of this category relative to the total expenses (0.00 - 100.00)

PeriodDto.description: The precise date and time boundaries used to filter and aggregate the financial data

fromDate.description: The starting date-time boundary of the analysis period (inclusive)

toDate.description: The ending date-time boundary of the analysis period (inclusive)
